newsitem.title: USA: Phily controller urges city to scrap tax - paper.
newsitem.headline: Phily controller urges city to scrap tax - paper.

text.p: Philadelphia Controller Jonathan Saidel is urging the city to scrap a tax on personal investments, Philadelphia Inquirer reported Wednesday.
The personal property tax, which is applied to investments on out-of-state companies, has prompted several local banks to shift jobs and accounts out of the city, the newspaper said.
Mayor Ed Rendell was set to meet Wednesday with banking leaders in an effort to resolve the dispute.
Several counties in the state have already abandoned the tax, on the expectation that the state Supreme Court will soon declare it unconstitutional.
